svg.aria-label: A flip phone inbox with three messages. Mohammad Harish: "the best frontend engineer i have seen in the entire tpot (this part of twitter)". Manu Prabhakar: "quickly adapted to different tech stacks and delivered features with great attention to detail". Alok Singh: "delivered the project within a very tight deadline without compromising on quality".
